description: Georges Hebrail and Alice Berard contributed electricity measurements from one household in Sceaux, France, to the UCI Machine Learning Repository. The record covers December 2006 to November 2010 at one-minute intervals. It reports 2,075,259 observations with active and reactive power, voltage, current and three submetering channels. Semicolon-delimited text is available through the public repository, free under CC BY 4.0. About 1.25 percent of rows have missing measurement values despite a complete timestamp sequence. The general missing-value statement conflicts with the variable table, which labels individual columns as having no missing values. These measured demand profiles support electricity-load modelling and forecasting; one dwelling does not establish population representativeness. PADELF supplied the discovery link. BuildingsBench is a related benchmark that incorporates the UCI household data. Only source metadata were checked; the measurement file was not downloaded.
